description: Make temporary code changes for testing that can be easily undone. Use when user says "temp", "temporary change", "temporarily enable/disable/show/hide", or needs to force a UI state, bypass a guard, or flip a feature flag for local testing. Also handles "temp undo" to revert all temporary changes, and "temp list" to show them.
